notes.title: Ironsmith Medieval Simulator - Devlog#1. Engraving System
notes.content:
[b]Hello there, blacksmiths.[/b]
From now on we will start the weekly devlogs, as we make progress we'll send you some sneak peeks of the features in our game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33905399/e4a91b8648188edf60cb97f896df1017638b6a9d.jpg[/img]
Video demonstration:
https://youtu.be/mdK0y_3XGV8

Today we would like to introduce you to engraving system in the game. Mainly, a sword is made of four components:

- Blade 
- Garde
- Handle
- Pommel

Each of these parts can be fully customised by engraving performed on working table. As the progress in the game goes forward, the player will eventually be able to unlock more features and styles to customise weapons in whatever style he likes.


What do you think about it? Is there anything else you want to see in engraving system or the game itself?
